Package org.apache.hadoop.yarn.server.applicationhistoryservice.records

Class ContainerFinishData

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.yarn.server.applicationhistoryservice.records.ContainerFinishData
Direct Known Subclasses:
ContainerFinishDataPBImpl
@Public @Unstable public abstract class ContainerFinishData extends Object
The class contains the fields that can be determined when RMContainer finishes, and that need to be stored persistently.
